rules.label: Discounted care for households at or below 250% FPL
rules.quote: If your gross household income is at or below 250% of the federal poverty level: o You may be able to get discounts on your health services.

notes: Policy does not specify asset limits for eligibility.
Policy does not define underinsured status explicitly.
Policy does not restrict eligibility based on residency, service area, emergency status, or application to public programs.
Policy allows eligibility regardless of citizenship or immigration status.
Policy requires hospitals to screen for public health coverage and discount programs.
Policy states that providers' monthly bills cannot exceed 2% of monthly income, but this is not modeled in payment_plan as it applies to provider billing, not hospital payment plans.
Policy includes appeal rights (30 days from decision) and complaint processes, but these are not modeled as they pertain to enforcement, not eligibility or assistance terms.

dropped.quote: The hospital must check to see if you qualify within 45 days of when you received the service or ask to be screened.
dropped.why: The 45-day deadline is for the hospital to check eligibility, not for the patient to submit an application.
